description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller named ProductKeywordsController that manages product keywords, including displaying, adding, removing, and paginating keywords associated with products in an admin web interface.

classes.name: ProductKeywordsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling product keyword management for the admin interface.

methods.name: displayKeywords
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the keywords management page for a specific product.

methods.name: addKeyword
methods.description: Handles POST request to add a new keyword to a product description in a specific language.

methods.name: removeKeyword
methods.description: Handles POST request to remove a specific keyword from a product description.

methods.name: pageKeywords
methods.description: Handles POST request to provide a paginated list of keywords for a product.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set menu attributes in the model for UI navigation.
